item.description: Energy International Energy Agency I worked at the International Energy Agency in the Tracking Sustainable Transtions team. While there, I co-authored the IEA’s inagural flagship report on Clean Cooking. I also helped build the IEA’s Database on GIS resources for energy planning (designed to help build capacity for GIS-based energy planning within energy ministries on the African continent).
